notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok 'yu' namel long vers, tasol画像 רישך/מחסריך (bilong yu) i soim man i stap.

notes.subject: מתהלך
notes.rationale: Man i wokabaut o man i stil (roba)? KJV 'travelleth', ASV/JPS 'robber/runner' — ראשׁ i kamap olsem birua i kam.

notes.subject: רישך/מחסריך
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i tanim wantaim — 'hangre bilong yu' na 'wanem i lus long yu' — parallelism bilong pinis bilong stori.

translation: Na hangre bilong yu bai i kamap olsem man i wokabaut, na wanem i lus long yu olsem man i holim sel bilong pait.

tokens.gloss: na wanem i lus long yu
